description:
Build the "Ledger" dashboard — revenue, subscriptions, and financial metrics.

**Theme: Vault**
Rich dark green background (old money/banking aesthetic). Gold typography for numbers. Clean serif fonts for hero revenue figures. Subtle paper/parchment texture overlay. Charts use gold gradients on dark green. Leather-bound ledger feel. Conveys trust and gravitas.

**Metrics — Available Now (dataSource: live, ~60% coverage):**
- Subscriber count by plan tier (free/solo/pro/studio/business) — query subscriptions WHERE status='active' GROUP BY plan_tier
- Subscriber count by status (active/trialing/past_due/canceled)
- Revenue by checkout session type (subscription/credits_topup/supporter_contribution) — checkout_sessions.amount_cents
- Credit wallet balance distribution across users
- Credit transaction volume by type (charge/topup/refund/bonus)
- Usage records — consumption patterns by limit_key per billing period
- Tier limit configurations
- Intro coupon usage tracking
- Subscription schedule data (intro vs normal pricing amounts)
- Bundle/app catalog size (download_apps count)
- Feedback requests by type and status

**Metrics — Partial (dataSource: partial):**
- MRR estimate — requires mapping price_id to dollar amounts (Stripe lookup or config)
- Basic churn — canceled_at count in recent period vs total active
- ARPU — total revenue / active subscriber count
- Intro-to-paid conversion — cross-reference intro_coupon_usage with active subscriptions

**Metrics — Ideal/Future (dataSource: gap):**
- LTV (lifetime value) per cohort
- Expansion revenue (upgrades between tiers)
- Net revenue retention rate
- Revenue forecasting (growth + churn trend projection)
- Dunning success rate (past_due → active recovery)
- Bundle comparison (which bundles drive most revenue)
- Trial-to-paid conversion funnel visualization
- Payment failure rate and recovery metrics

**Layout concept:** Hero MRR/ARR number in gold at top. Tier breakdown as stacked bars or pie. Subscriber trend line. Churn indicator. Credit system health. Revenue waterfall showing sources.
name: command-center-ledger-page
title: Build Ledger dashboard — revenue and subscriptions with Vault theme
